title: helianthemum glabrum
intro: Helianthemum glabrum, commonly known as Smooth Rockrose, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Helianthemum glabrum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
